:::{#def-upper-bound}
#### Upper bound

Let $A \subseteq \reals$.
A real number $\ubound$ is an **upper bound** for $A$
[@wikipedia_upper_and_lower_bounds]
if $a \le \ubound$ for all $a \in A$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-lower-bound}
#### Lower bound

Let $A \subseteq \reals$.
A real number $\lbound$ is a **lower bound** for $A$
[@wikipedia_upper_and_lower_bounds]
if $\lbound \le a$ for all $a \in A$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-bounded-above}
#### Bounded above

A set $A \subseteq \reals$ is **bounded above** if it has an upper bound (@def-upper-bound).
A real-valued [function](functions.qmd#def-function) is
bounded above
if its [image](functions.qmd#def-image) is.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-bounded-below}
#### Bounded below

A set $A \subseteq \reals$ is **bounded below** if it has a lower bound (@def-lower-bound).
A real-valued [function](functions.qmd#def-function) is
bounded below
if its [image](functions.qmd#def-image) is.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-bounded}
#### Bounded

A set $A \subseteq \reals$ is **bounded**
if it is both bounded above (@def-bounded-above) and bounded below (@def-bounded-below).
A real-valued [function](functions.qmd#def-function) is
bounded
if its [image](functions.qmd#def-image) is.

:::
